description: The implementation table of every v4 state machine (requirements-compiled/v4/state-machines.json, frozen), with the transitions the owner approved in analysis/state-machine-amendments.json, generated by requirements-compiler v41: each (state, event) pair is either legal, with its transitions (guard, next state, effects, test case; an amended transition names its decision in amendedBy), or illegal. No state or event is added. Unlisted pairs are illegal by the v4 rule, so every pair is decided; where a pair has several transitions, its guards are the reviewed partition of analysis/guard-partitions.json. A transition's test drives the machine through it and asserts the next state and the effects; the illegal-pair test enumerates every illegal pair. Test files and owners are in agent-file-ownership.json.

invalidTransition.rule: Any (state, event) pair not listed fails closed with a typed fault naming the state and the event; state, base head and unsaved changes are unchanged.
invalidTransition.behaviour: fail closed: return Error SaveFault { Machine; State; Input; Reason }, emit no effect, keep state, base head and unsaved changes

evidence: the state-machine tests' results in the CI test record of the commit (TRX), one result per transition test and one per machine for the illegal pairs
